title: GENERAL HUMAN NUTRITION
description: The relationship of food, its nutrients and other components to the promotion of health and fitness with emphasis on the young adult. Current health concerns on a national and international level. This course is for non-majors; NES majors and those in the health sciences should take NUTR 240.
registration_restrictions: Students cannot enroll who have a program in Nutrition & Food Mgt (420), Nutrition (466), Exercise and Sport Science (716) or Kinesiology (840).
books_html: No-cost: Course utilizes open educational resources, materials available through the library, or does not require any purchased materials.
clssnotes:
Hybrid section; both on-site meetings and online component. For non-majors. NUTR, KIN and Health Sciences majors should take NUTR 240 lecture.
